# Worknotes: `<incident number>`

Use this file for ServiceNow-copyable internal worknotes. Keep entries factual,
timestamped, concise, and evidence-based. Do not claim root cause until the
resolution gate is ready for human review.

```text
[<timestamp>] <action taken>.
Result: <what was observed>.
Outcome: <what this proves, disproves, or leaves unknown>.
Next: <next small action or blocker>.
```

## Worknote Entries

```text
[<timestamp>] Started incident investigation.
Result: ServiceNow details are pending.
Outcome: No root cause, impact, workaround, or validation confirmed yet.
Next: Capture ticket details and first technical evidence.
```
